VAR-age.why: Individual age (continuous) recorded as indata.b4 age

VAR-agecat.why: Age categories can be derived from indata.b4 age

VAR-childmth.why: Child age in months (<5) can be derived from indata.b4 age (years) if needed

VAR-childyr.why: Child age in years (<5) can be derived from indata.b4 age

VAR-relationcs.why: Relationship to household head appears as indata.b3 lien de parenté avec le chef de ménage

VAR-relationharm.why: Harmonized relationship can be mapped from indata.b3 relationship-to-head categories

VAR-marital.why: Marital status appears as indata.b5 etat matrimonial

VAR-literacy.why: Literacy appears as indata.c1 sait lire et écrire dans une langue quelconque

VAR-everattend.why: Ever attended school appears as indata.c2 est-il déjà allé à l'école

VAR-school.why: Current school attendance approximated by indata.c5 attendance during school year 2007-2008 (and nearby c4 for 2006-2007)

VAR-educat4.why: Highest education level likely from indata.educ Niveau instruction (5-level); may be recoded to 4 categories

VAR-educat5.why: Highest education level likely from indata.educ Niveau instruction (5-level), candidate for 5-category harmonization

VAR-educat7.why: Detailed highest class completed indata.c3 plus haute classe achevée can support 7-level education mapping

VAR-educy.why: Years of education likely derivable from highest class completed (indata.c3) and/or current level (indata.educ)

VAR-primarycomp.why: Primary completion can be derived from highest class completed indata.c3 (primary grades completed) and/or indata.educ

VAR-mineducatage.why: Minimum education age is a survey parameter; derive from the education section's universe/onset around indata.c2/c3/c4/c5 rather than a single data column

VAR-communicationdisability.why: No domain-specific functional difficulty items found; only disability-related item is indata.d3 (handicap/infirm), candidate to review

VAR-concentrationdisorder.why: No concentration-specific item found; only general handicap item indata.d3 is a candidate to inspect

VAR-eyedisability.why: No vision-difficulty item found; only general handicap item indata.d3 is a candidate to inspect

VAR-heardisability.why: No hearing-difficulty item found; only general handicap item indata.d3 is a candidate to inspect

VAR-selfcaredisability.why: No self-care difficulty item found; only general handicap item indata.d3 is a candidate to inspect

VAR-walkdisability.why: No walking difficulty item found; only general handicap item indata.d3 is a candidate to inspect

VAR-language.why: No language variable found in the survey column index via search; check questionnaire/other modules if language was collected
